[[The Bloodspear]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[spear]] dropped by [[Lord Jadoth]], a [[boss]] who can be found in the [[City of Torc'qua]].

==Stats==
: [[Piercing damage]]: 14-27 (Requires 9 [[Spear Mastery]])
: [[Damage]] +15% (while [[Health]] is above 50%) 
: [[Life Draining]]: 3
: [[Health regeneration]] -1
: [[Health]] +30

==Skin==
This item uses the same [[skin]] as [[Turep's Spear]], [[Mallyx's Cruelty]], and [[Mallyx's Strife]].
